chunks: And from him, from Zur'a, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) regarding

a Muslim man who killed a man from the Ahl al-Dhimma. So he (peace be upon him) said: 'This is a harsh Hadith, the people cannot bear it, but the Dhimmi must pay the blood money of the Muslim, then the Muslim would be killed due to it'.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ: People of the treaty/protection (non-Muslims living under Islamic rule)
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ بِهِ: He is killed due to it (retribution)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when a Muslim kills a Dhimmi according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates a severe legal precedent where a Muslim who kills a Dhimmi is executed after the Dhimmi’s heirs pay the Muslim’s full blood money (diyah), a ruling described as 'harsh' yet legally sound. This mechanism ensures the Muslim’s life is valued higher than the Dhimmi’s, effectively using the Dhimmi’s financial contribution to purchase the Muslim’s execution, thereby maintaining the hierarchy of blood money while enforcing retribution (qisas).

en.hubeali: And from him, from Zurara, from Sama’at,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding a Muslim man who kills a man from the Zimmy people. So heasws said: ‘This is a harsh Hadeeth, the people cannot bear it, but the Zimmy has to give the wergild of the Muslim, then the Muslim would be killed due to it’.
